summary: A controlled device-kernel split identifies the gfx1151 Q4T16 selected-dual shared-X route as the repeated-128K stall trigger. Conservative and exact-GDN profiles each pass 12/12 prefills; shared-X reproduces the target no-progress state on its fourth prefill; changing only Q4 selected prefill to baseline passes 12/12. gfx1151 automatic dispatch therefore falls back to baseline while gfx1100 and the explicit shared-X diagnostic remain unchanged.

platform.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

source.implementation: Same logical commit as this artifact changes only the gfx1151 package automatic Q4T16 selected-prefill mode from shared_x to baseline; the kernel bodies and gfx1100 policy are unchanged.
source.working_tree: Pre-existing unrelated untracked benchmark outputs were present and excluded.

protocol.session: Three independent right-sized resident processes per passing 128K arm; one process was sufficient once shared-X reproduced the predeclared target failure.
protocol.command_template: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 1800s uv run python scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --workloads 128K/128 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --compiler-version-file <precomputed> --require-cached-build --prefill-flight-recorder <output> --prefill-flight-recorder-granularity chunk --prefill-queue-drain none --prefill-kernel-profile {conservative|gdn_exact|q4_shared_x|q4_baseline} --json <output>

conservative.selector_delta: Exact GDN chain, Q4 baseline, convolution baseline, router 512, host metadata

q4_shared_x.telemetry_signature: 100% GPU activity, approximately 2.9 GHz gfx clock, approximately 48 W socket / 9.72 W gfx power

isolated_route.role: Q4T16 selected-expert dual gate+up bulk prefill
isolated_route.source_change: Compared with baseline, shared-X moves the two-output-half loop inside the K loop, keeps two WMMA accumulator arrays live, and reuses one activation fragment for both halves.
isolated_route.interpretation: The controlled A/B identifies this route as the application-kernel trigger for the observed gfx1151 no-progress state. It does not identify a particular ISA instruction or prove whether the defect is in device code, compiler output, firmware, or runtime queue handling.

validation.red: Two focused assertions fail before the gfx1151 package constant changes: automatic resolver selects shared-X and the architecture policy reports shared_x.
validation.green: 56/56 focused dispatch, backend, profile, and Q4T16 primitive tests pass with HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151.

decision.reason: The same controlled matrix that reproduces with shared-X passes the full predeclared gate when only that registry route is replaced by baseline.
decision.next: Keep shared-X explicit for focused repair and A/B work. Restore it automatically on gfx1151 only after the repaired body passes primitive correctness, kernel tracing, and the three-independent-process repeated-128K gate.
